highest_impact_findings: The apparent 370.35M XRP Evernorth outflow is strongly supported as a BitGo custody reorganization, not a verified sale or exchange deposit.

Nine Bithomp destination pages opened in this run show the BitGo Initialization Wallet as activator and multisig control; Q-Eternal reports the full 19-account source/destination set is 2-of-3 multisig.
The ten-destination balance table maps five disclosed categories but omits the separate 600,000 XRP advance-funding subscriber tranche.
Two later tagged deposits of 5.223608M and 3.846154M XRP to the cash-purchased-tranche wallet total 9.069762M XRP; sender and beneficial owner are not identified, so no purchase is confirmed.
The SEC filing's $80.7M ELOC summary number is arithmetically consistent with $15.46, while cover and detailed sections use $14.71/$76.8M and $74.4M net; likely stale summary price, no draw verified.

The SEC prospectus says yield/DeFi participation commenced following Closing, but material deployment was not anticipated before Q4 2026 and all XRP was in cold storage as of the prospectus date; actual deployed XRP and collateral remain unknown.

Map the 600,000 XRP Advance Funding Subscribers tranche to an address or leave it explicitly unresolved.
Trace rBKr and the unlabelled sender rUWUJ2F3... across subsequent ledgers; determine whether 5.223608M and 3.846154M are custody/client transfers or new Evernorth purchases.
Reconcile the 200,137.78 XRP difference without forcing attribution.
Check Evernorth's next SEC filings and any protocol disclosures for actual XRP lending, collateral, covered calls, basis trades, RLUSD pools or other yield activity.
Track ELOC draw notices and issuer share issuance; do not count the facility as cash until actual shares are issued and proceeds received.
Keep custody reorganization out of market-flow features; keep candidate deposits quarantined until ownership and purchase status are verified.
